cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I kept twelve tickets from our trips. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: None. I made you that album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. And I kept it. Your care is safe because of mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. I put all my tickets inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm preserving both our collections. Let me get it a waterproof cover.

mechanism: A treats caring as skilled work and corrects B's help to establish that A cares more.
confusable: Generic competitiveness is insufficient: professional correction must turn affection into A's superior care.
comparison: Album preservation competes over memories; carrying a shared load competes over physical sacrifice.
seedUse: Use the album and shared-bag causal seeds, replacing the detached professional announcements.
